environment: Local QEMU emulator only; no physical AZ access
observations: Main FAT suite passed 11 checks on the candidate.
Boundary touch/raw-block refusal and retry reached safe state, but native USB1 remained mounted after forwarded 2.3-second and 5-second holds.
An explicit EP147 restart with the community enabled list empty confirmed no usb-hub-support mapping; a 5-second native USB1 STOP unmounted sda1.

After restoring the same candidate in another fresh EP147 session, a 5-second native USB1 STOP also unmounted sda1. The failure therefore depends on session history or timing; a general forwarding failure is not established.

Repeating the complete boundary suite after restoring the candidate passed touch refusal/retry and native USB1 short/2.3-second long STOP, with USB1 restored at the end. The original failed sequential run remains recorded.
